summary.intent: Investigate where the warning 'transcript flush sentinel not found within timeout' was coming from and eliminate it from the attach command path.
summary.outcome: Added logging.Init to runAttach so all logging calls write to .entire/logs/ instead of stderr, and restored the PrepareTranscript interface call that had been incorrectly removed.

repo: logging.Init is only called in hooks_git_cmd.go and clean.go — the attach command never initialized the logger, so all logging.Warn/Info/Debug calls fell through to the default slog handler and printed to stderr.

PrepareTranscript is an interface method — removing the call from attach.go entirely was wrong because non-ClaudeCode agents may implement it to materialize transcripts from a database or other source.

waitForTranscriptFlush has a staleThreshold check (2 min): transcripts older than 2 min skip the 3s sentinel wait. The warning only surfaces for freshly-written transcripts, which is why it appeared in tests but not typical attach usage.
resolveAndValidateTranscript is only used in attach.go — confirmed safe to modify without affecting other callers.

code.finding: PrepareTranscript calls waitForTranscriptFlush which polls 3s for a sentinel; skipped if transcript file is older than staleThreshold (2 min).
runAttach now calls logging.Init at startup; PrepareTranscript call via agent.AsTranscriptPreparer interface check was restored after being incorrectly removed.
getLogger() returns the default slog logger if Init has not been called, which writes to stderr rather than .entire/logs/.

workflow: When removing a call to silence a warning, check whether the call is part of an interface contract before removing it — the correct fix was upstream (initialize the logger) not downstream (delete the call).
Verify logger initialization early when diagnosing unexpected stderr output — the root cause was missing logging.Init, not the warning itself.

friction: PrepareTranscript was removed prematurely without considering the interface contract; had to be restored in a later step.
Editing attach.go caused a formatting regression that required rewriting runAttach from scratch.
git diff output was stale during the logging cleanup, causing confusion about current file state and requiring direct Grep to verify.
open_items: The 3s sentinel wait still fires for transcripts written less than 2 minutes before attach is run (e.g., in tests or immediately after a session ends) — no fix for this edge case was landed.
Consider adding an explicit 'session complete' signal or flag to PrepareTranscript so agents can skip the sentinel wait when the session is known to be finished.
